data.one_liner: A configurable spacing and design token system for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a consistent spacing scale, EdgeInsets extensions, and gap widgets based on a configurable base unit. It helps maintain design consistency across your application by standardizing margins and padding values.
use_when: You want a consistent, scalable spacing system across your Flutter application
You need convenient EdgeInsets extensions and gap widgets based on design tokens
avoid_when: You already have a comprehensive design system framework handling spacing
You prefer using raw pixel values for all layouts
strengths: Convenient EdgeInsets extensions for padding and margins
weaknesses: Limited to spacing management and tokens only
data.setup_notes: Optionally initialize the base spacing unit in your main function.
